vectors.name: evm_message_1024_bytes
vectors.note: the cap; the prefix length is "1024"

vectors.name: evm_message_0x_uppercase_input
vectors.note: hex input with 0X and uppercase: same bytes as evm_message_hello

vectors.name: evm_message_hex_text_of_a_tx
vectors.note: text that spells a tx in hex is just text: the prefix keeps it from ever being a tx hash

vectors.name: evm_message_raw_tx_bytes
vectors.note: raw transaction bytes are not text

vectors.name: evm_message_raw_32_byte_hash
vectors.note: personal_sign(bytes32) blind signing: a raw hash is not text

vectors.name: sol_message_newline_format1
vectors.note: a newline is not printable ASCII → format 1

vectors.name: sol_message_tilde_and_space
vectors.note: 0x20 and 0x7e are the printable bounds → format 0

vectors.name: sol_message_legacy_tx_bytes
vectors.note: a legacy transaction message is not text (and could never be signed as one: the header starts with 0xff)
